Find common elements of two sorted arrays

Given two sorted arrays of lengths `m` and `n` respectively, scan them simultaneously and identify their common elements.

Stable compaction

Retain, in-place, only those elements of an array that satisfy a predicate while preserving their relative order.

Remove all occurrences of a value

Remove every occurrence of `target` from an array in-place while preserving the order of the remaining elements.

Move all occurrences of a value to the end

Move every occurrence of `target` to the end of the while preserving the order of the remaining elements.

Deduplicate a sorted array

Given a sorted array, remove duplicates in-place so each distinct value appears exactly once, preserving sorted order.

Deduplicate a sorted array — keep at most `k` copies

Given a sorted array, remove duplicates in-place so each distinct value appears at most `k` times, preserving sorted order.

Group equal elements

Identify the start and end of each contiguous group of equal values in an array `arr`.

Group increasing runs

Identify the start and end index of all increasing runs in an array `arr`.
